assets.name: cash-tip-flat
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the edit target: an existing blank Unity status speech-bubble sprite. Image 2 is the previously approved whole-screen AI preview and is ONLY a style reference for the two slim white status bubbles below the Cash panels. Output ONLY the isolated blank edited sprite, never the screen and never the text. Preserve the original very wide rounded rectangle silhouette, centered small upward pointer, outer bounds and aspect ratio. Match the approved preview: opaque near-white #FFFDF8 fill with uniform very subtle warm tint, ONE fine single-color outline about 2 pixels thick when scaled to a 527x99-pixel asset. Make the face essentially flat. Remove the existing thick double rim, metallic bevel, gold/brown inner stroke, yellow cream gradient, glossy highlights and colored halo. A tiny soft neutral shadow only, not a deep inset or button bevel. Crisp clean edge and calm white empty interior for existing dynamic red/navy text. Genuine RGBA transparent canvas outside the full complete silhouette, all edges visible with a small clear margin. NO WORDS, NO letters, NO amounts, NO currency symbols, NO logos, NO icons, NO ornament. The original runtime text, size and position are separate and must not be baked in.
Outline is soft leaf green #8ACD59, like the LEFT status bubble in Image 2. Its line is consistently thin, including at the upward pointer; no dark green outside stroke.
